name: 10Web

name: AltText.ai

name: Apollo.io
description: AI-assisted lead sourcing and outreach sequencing, from $49/user/month.

name: Astra Security
description: AI-assisted vulnerability scanning and penetration testing built to be accessible for smaller teams.

name: Async
description: A browser-based podcast and video studio combining remote recording, multi-track editing, AI noise cleanup, and voice cloning in one platform.

name: Auphonic
description: AI audio post-production that automatically levels, cleans up noise, and masters podcast episodes.

name: Beautiful.ai

name: Beehiiv
description: Newsletter platform built for monetization from day one; 0% commission on paid subscriptions.

name: Bland AI
description: Programmable AI voice agents billed per minute, from $0.14/min.

name: Bonsai

name: Calm

name: Monarch Money
description: A budgeting and financial tracking app that gives a single clear view of spending, saving, and net worth.
cool_fact: Built to give a full household financial picture in one dashboard, not just a single account view.

name: Motion
description: AI calendar that auto-schedules your tasks around meetings; no free plan.
cool_fact: Automatically re-shuffles your task schedule the moment a new meeting gets booked.

name: Murf AI
description: AI voiceover generation aimed at studio-quality narration for videos and presentations.
cool_fact: Includes a built-in voice changer that converts your own recorded voice into polished narration.

name: MyArchitectAI
description: Generates interior and exterior design renders from a photo or sketch, with a free tier covering 10 renders and 10 edits before $29/month plans kick in.
cool_fact: It renders both interior room redesigns and full exterior architectural concepts from the same tool, most competitors only do one or the other.

name: MyFitnessPal
description: AI-assisted food logging and calorie tracking, including logging a meal from a photo.
cool_fact: Can estimate a full meal's nutrition breakdown from a single photo instead of manual entry.

name: n8n
description: An open-source workflow automation platform that connects hundreds of apps together.
cool_fact: Because it's open-source, you can self-host it for free instead of paying per task.

name: Noom
description: An AI-assisted behavior-change program aimed at weight loss through psychology-based coaching, not just calorie counts.
cool_fact: Built around cognitive-behavioral psychology, focused on why people eat, not just what they eat.

name: NotebookLM
description: Google's source-grounded AI notebook; free tier covers 100 notebooks and 50 chats a day.
cool_fact: Refuses to answer from general knowledge, every response is grounded in the documents you actually upload.

name: Notion AI
description: Notion's AI layer now requires the $20/user/month Business plan.
cool_fact: Can build a tracker or database directly from a meeting summary you paste in.

name: Notion Mail
description: An inbox built with Notion's UI that auto-labels incoming email and can reference your Notion pages directly from AI, though AI features require a Business plan or higher.
cool_fact: Notion retired its standalone $10 AI add-on in 2025, so Notion Mail's AI features now require a Business or Enterprise plan, no a la carte option anymore.

name: NovelAI
description: A subscription AI tool for fiction writing and anime-style image generation, built by a small studio called Anlatan.
cool_fact: Bundles a fiction-tuned text model and an anime-trained image model in the same private workspace.

name: Numerous.ai
description: AI formulas that live inside Google Sheets and Excel, from $8/month billed yearly.
cool_fact: Lets you write a plain-language instruction as a spreadsheet formula instead of a nested function.

name: Obviously AI
description: No-code predictive modeling, upload a spreadsheet and get a working machine learning prediction in minutes.
cool_fact: Built specifically so a non-technical business user can train a real ML model without writing any code.

name: Ocoya
description: AI social media scheduling and caption generation across 30+ platforms, with a free tier to start and paid plans from $19/month.
cool_fact: It bundles AI copywriting directly into the scheduling calendar, so captions, hashtags, and post variations get generated on the same screen where you queue the post.

name: OpenAI Codex
description: OpenAI's coding agent, bundled into every ChatGPT plan including Free, that builds features, fixes bugs, and proposes pull requests in the cloud or your terminal.
cool_fact: There is no separate Codex subscription. It rides along with ChatGPT, though the command-line version starts at the $20/month Plus plan.

name: OpusClip
description: Turns long-form video into short social clips automatically, from $15/month.
cool_fact: Scores every auto-generated clip by predicted engagement before you post it.

name: Originality.ai
description: Combines AI-content detection with traditional plagiarism checking in one tool aimed at publishers and agencies.
cool_fact: Built specifically for content teams who need to verify a writer's submission wasn't AI-generated before paying for it.

name: Otter.ai
description: Real-time meeting transcription and summaries; Business tier bills a 5-seat minimum.
cool_fact: Can join a call automatically and start transcribing without anyone manually starting a recorder.

name: PandaDoc
description: AI-assisted proposals, quotes, contracts, and e-signatures in one document workflow.
cool_fact: Tracks exactly when a recipient opens and scrolls through a document, before they ever sign it.

name: Paradox
description: A conversational AI recruiting assistant (Olivia) that screens candidates and schedules interviews by text and chat.
cool_fact: Handles high-volume hourly hiring for retail and healthcare chains, where speed to first contact matters most.

name: Perplexity Comet
description: Perplexity's AI-native web browser that reads, researches, and can act on the page you're viewing.
cool_fact: Free for all Perplexity account holders, unusual for a browser built around a paid AI subscription product.

name: Perplexity Pro
description: Cited, sourced AI search; a nice-to-have if you already pay for another AI assistant.
cool_fact: Answers link directly back to the specific source they came from, not just a generic citation list.

name: Photoroom
description: AI background removal and product photo editing, from $7.50/month billed yearly.
cool_fact: Purpose-built for e-commerce product photos rather than general design work.

name: Pictory
description: Turns long-form video, blog posts, or scripts into short, branded video clips automatically.
cool_fact: Can generate a finished short video directly from a blog post URL, no footage of your own required.

name: Pika
description: An AI video generator focused on quick, stylized clips and creative effects.
cool_fact: Popular for its one-click visual effects library, objects exploding, melting, and transforming.

name: Pitch
description: A collaborative presentation tool built for teams, with real-time multiplayer editing and AI slide generation, free to start with paid plans from around $11/seat/month.
cool_fact: It was built by former Wunderlist founders specifically to fix the parts of pitch decks that get stuck in email attachments and version-numbered filenames.

name: PixVerse
description: An AI video generator focused on fast text-to-video and image-to-video clips with built-in style templates.
cool_fact: Includes a library of one-click effect templates, aimed at quick social clips rather than long-form production work.

name: Play.ht
description: AI text-to-speech and voice cloning aimed at podcasts, audiobooks, and apps.
cool_fact: Offers ultra-realistic voice cloning from just a short audio sample.

name: Plus AI
description: An AI slide generator that works as an add-on directly inside Google Slides and PowerPoint.
cool_fact: Builds and edits decks inside the presentation software you already use, instead of a separate app to export from.

name: Podium
description: AI-assisted text messaging, review requests, and lead follow-up built for local service businesses.
cool_fact: Built specifically to move phone and walk-in leads into text conversations, where response rates run far higher.

name: Poe
description: Quora's chat platform that gives you access to dozens of different AI models under one subscription.
cool_fact: Lets you compare answers from GPT, Claude, Gemini, and other models side by side in the same place.

name: ProWritingAid
description: An AI-enhanced grammar and style editor built for long-form writing like novels and manuscripts, not just short-form copy.
cool_fact: Runs dozens of specialized reports, pacing, dialogue tags, sentence-length variation, well beyond a basic grammar check.

name: QuickBooks Solopreneur
description: Bookkeeping built for one-person Schedule-C businesses, not a scaled-down QuickBooks Online.
cool_fact: Built from scratch specifically for one-person businesses, not just a trimmed-down version of the full product.

name: QuillBot
description: A paraphrasing and grammar tool that also includes a free AI detector and plagiarism checker.
cool_fact: Started purely as a paraphrasing tool before expanding into detection as AI-written text became common to check for.

name: Quizlet
description: AI-assisted flashcards and study tools that generate practice questions from your own notes.
cool_fact: Can turn a pasted set of class notes into a full practice test in seconds.

name: Rask AI
description: AI dubbing and lip-sync that translates a video into another language, matching mouth movements to the new audio.
cool_fact: Clones the original speaker's voice into 130+ languages instead of swapping in a generic narrator.

name: Raycast
description: A free launcher for apps, clipboard history, windows, and snippets, with Raycast AI chat and commands on Pro from $10/month.
cool_fact: Screen awareness lets the AI read what is on your screen right now, so you can ask about it without copying and pasting.

name: Read AI
description: An AI meeting assistant that transcribes and summarizes Zoom, Meet, and Teams calls. Free for 5 transcripts a month, Pro from $15/month.
cool_fact: Ask Read searches across your meetings, email, and chat at once, so you can find what was decided without rewatching anything.

name: Reclaim.ai
description: An AI calendar tool that auto-schedules habits, focus time, and tasks around your existing meetings, with a genuinely free tier for a single calendar.
cool_fact: Automatically defends time for recurring habits like exercise or deep work, rescheduling them itself the moment a meeting collides.

name: Recraft
description: AI image generation built for designers: brand-consistent graphics, icons, and layouts.
cool_fact: One of the only AI image tools that natively outputs scalable SVG files, not just flat images.

name: Recruiterflow
description: A combined applicant tracking system and CRM built specifically for recruitment agencies.
cool_fact: Bundles one of the largest suites of AI recruiting agents into a single platform, from sourcing to outreach.

name: Reflect
description: A networked note-taking app with AI built in, designed around linking ideas together over time.
cool_fact: Syncs in real time across every device with no manual save step.

name: RemodelAI
description: Photorealistic room redesigns from a single photo, plus exterior, virtual staging, and paint-color tools.
cool_fact: Offers 30+ distinct design styles and lets you try several before committing to a real renovation.

name: Replit
description: A browser-based coding environment where Replit Agent can build, run, and deploy a full app from a plain-language prompt, free to start with paid Core at $20/month plus usage-based credits.
cool_fact: The subscription is really just the base fee, actively building with the Agent burns separate usage credits that can add another five to twenty dollars a day on top.

name: Respeecher
description: Ethical AI voice cloning built for film, game, and dubbing studios, with consent-based licensing per voice.
cool_fact: Requires the original voice owner's explicit consent for every clone, built specifically to avoid deepfake misuse.

name: Rev
description: AI plus human-reviewed captions, transcripts, and subtitles built for accessibility compliance.
cool_fact: Blends AI speed with human review, useful when captions need to be legally accurate, not just close enough.

name: Rezi
description: An ATS-safe AI resume builder aimed specifically at tech job seekers, sold as a lifetime plan.
cool_fact: Built its formatting specifically to survive strict ATS parsing rather than to look good to a human first.

name: Riverside.fm
description: Studio-quality remote podcast and video recording with local-device recording.
cool_fact: Records each guest locally at full quality, so a bad internet connection doesn't degrade the final file.

name: Robin AI
description: An AI contract review and negotiation assistant used by legal and business teams to speed up redlining.
cool_fact: Can compare a contract against a company's own playbook and flag every clause that deviates from it.

name: Rocket Money
description: Tracks spending, subscriptions, and net worth, and can negotiate bills or cancel subscriptions on your behalf.
cool_fact: Will actually call and negotiate a lower bill for you, not just flag that a bill went up.

name: Rows
description: A spreadsheet built with AI formulas and live data connectors baked in from the start.
cool_fact: Can pull live data directly from APIs and other apps into a cell, instead of a manual copy-paste import.

name: Runway
description: AI video generation and editing for solo creators, from $15/month.
cool_fact: Its Act-Two feature captures a real performance and maps it onto a generated character.

name: Rytr
description: A budget AI writing assistant covering short-form marketing copy, emails, and social posts.
cool_fact: Its free plan supports a genuinely usable monthly character allowance, not just a one-time trial.

name: Sanebox
description: An inbox filtering tool that quietly sorts newsletters, notifications, and noise out of your main inbox using folder rules instead of AI chat, from $7/month for one account.
cool_fact: It's been running the same folder-based filtering approach since 2010, one of the few tools on this entire list that predates the AI boom by over a decade.

name: Seeking Alpha Premium
description: AI-assisted stock research that summarizes earnings, analyst ratings, and financial data into a single report per stock.
cool_fact: Its Virtual Analyst Reports condense hours of financial-statement reading into one structured summary.

name: Semrush
description: A comprehensive SEO research platform with AI-assisted content and keyword tools, from $139.95/month.
cool_fact: Widely considered the most capable SEO tool in its category, though the price is overkill unless organic content is your core growth channel.

name: Shopify Magic
description: AI features built directly into Shopify: product descriptions, email content, and image editing.
cool_fact: Included at no extra cost inside every Shopify plan, rather than sold as a separate add-on.

name: Shortwave
description: AI email client that triages and summarizes your inbox; $18/seat/month for Pro.
cool_fact: Lets you search your inbox in plain language instead of exact keyword matching.

name: Sider
description: A browser sidebar extension that puts GPT, Claude, Gemini, and 20+ other models on any webpage, summarizing pages, chatting with PDFs, and translating without switching tabs.
cool_fact: Started in 2019 as a simple ChatGPT sidebar and has grown into a platform with over 10 million active users.

name: Simplified
description: A bundled marketing suite combining a no-code design editor, AI writer, video editor, and social scheduler in one subscription, aimed at small teams that don't want five separate tools.
cool_fact: The free plan's AI writing credits are a one-time allotment of about 5,000 words that never renews, everything after that requires upgrading.

name: Smartlead
description: Cold email sending software built for scale, with unlimited mailboxes and inbox warmup on every plan starting at $39/month.
cool_fact: The subscription price is really just the sequencer, budget several times the plan cost for the mailboxes, domains, and verification credits that actually get the emails delivered.

name: Soundraw
description: Generates royalty-free AI music customized by mood, genre, and length for videos and content.
cool_fact: Lets you edit the structure of a generated track, swapping sections in and out, instead of taking it as-is.

name: Sourcegraph Cody
description: A code-search-powered AI assistant that answers questions and writes code with full awareness of your codebase, now positioned as an enterprise product after Sourcegraph dropped its free individual and Pro tiers.
cool_fact: As of 2026 it's enterprise-only, contracts are reported to start around sixteen thousand dollars, a sharp turn from the free-and-cheap positioning it had a year earlier.

name: Spellbook
description: AI contract drafting and review that runs natively inside Microsoft Word, aimed at small and mid-size law firms.
cool_fact: Flags risky clauses and suggests redlines directly in the Word document a lawyer is already working in.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: An open-weight image generation model that anyone can download, run locally, and fine-tune.
cool_fact: Because it's open-weight, it spawned an entire ecosystem of community fine-tunes and tools built on top of it.

name: StoryChief
description: A content marketing platform that plans, writes, and distributes posts across blog, social, and email at once.
cool_fact: Its AI writing assistant is connected to live SEO data, not just general-purpose chat.

name: Sudowrite
description: An AI writing tool built specifically for fiction writers, novels, short stories, and worldbuilding.
cool_fact: Its Story Bible feature tracks your characters and plot so the AI stays consistent across a long manuscript.

name: Suno
description: AI music generation that turns a text prompt into a full song with vocals and structure, from $8/month billed yearly.
cool_fact: Its latest model closes most of the uncanny valley in AI vocals, they sound like a real singer now.

name: Superhuman
description: A premium, keyboard-shortcut-driven email client for Gmail and Outlook whose Auto Drafts feature writes full reply drafts in your voice before you even open the email.
cool_fact: Starts at $30/month with no free tier, one of the more expensive ways to check email on this entire list.

name: Superwhisper
description: AI voice dictation for Mac and iOS that types in any app, running on local AI models, free or $8.49/month for cloud models and file transcription.
cool_fact: Runs entirely on-device using local AI models, so the free tier works offline with no word cap and no account required.

name: Surfer SEO
description: AI content optimization that scores a draft against what's actually ranking on the live search results page.
cool_fact: Rescans the live SERP each time, so its recommendations shift as competing pages change, not a static checklist.

name: Synthesia
description: Turns a script into a talking-avatar video, from $14/month.
cool_fact: Offers 125+ AI avatars to choose from without ever appearing on camera yourself.

name: Tabnine
description: An AI code-completion tool that can run fully privately, on your own infrastructure or offline.
cool_fact: One of the earliest AI coding tools on the market, it predates most of today's AI-native code editors.

name: Tana
description: A node-based notes app where every piece of information is a structured object with its own properties.
cool_fact: Its 'supertag' system applies consistent structure and AI auto-tagging across your whole knowledge base as you type.

name: Teal
description: An AI resume builder with a built-in job tracker for managing multiple applications at once.
cool_fact: Its Job Matcher feature highlights exactly which skills and keywords a resume is missing for a specific job post.

name: Tidio
description: AI chatbot and live chat aimed at small online stores that need support coverage without a support team.
cool_fact: Built specifically for small e-commerce sellers rather than enterprise support desks.

name: tl;dv
description: An AI meeting recorder and transcription tool for Zoom, Meet, and Teams with unlimited free recordings and 10 free AI summaries a month before paid plans start at $18/user/month.
cool_fact: The free plan's recording and transcription limits are genuinely unlimited, the only real cap is on AI-generated meeting summaries, most competitors throttle recording itself.

name: Toggl Track
description: Time tracking with AI-assisted categorization; free for up to 5 users.
cool_fact: Free plan supports up to 5 users at no cost, unusually generous for a time tracker.

name: Tripo AI
description: Text or image-to-3D generation built for speed, exporting directly to game engine-friendly formats.
cool_fact: Can produce a usable 3D model in as little as 8 seconds, with bridges into Blender, Unity, and Unreal.

name: Turnitin
description: Plagiarism and AI-writing detection built for universities, scoring submitted papers for both copied text and AI-generated patterns. Institutional-only, no public pricing, license quotes commonly run five to twenty thousand dollars a year depending on size.
cool_fact: Turnitin says it keeps false positives under 1% by only flagging documents where AI-generated content clears a 20% threshold, a tradeoff that means it also misses an estimated 15% of real AI-written text outright.

name: Typeform
description: Conversational forms and surveys with AI-assisted question generation, from $28/month.
cool_fact: Presents one question at a time in a full-screen format, which measurably raises completion rates.

name: Udio
description: AI music generation known for coherent full songs with mixed, separable tracks.
cool_fact: Exports separate vocal, drum, bass, and instrument stems so you can remix the output in real music software.

name: Uizard
description: An AI tool that turns rough sketches or text prompts into clickable app and website mockups.
cool_fact: Can convert a photo of a hand-drawn wireframe into an editable digital design.

name: v0
description: Vercel's AI tool that generates real, working frontend UI code from a prompt or screenshot, free or from $30/user/month.
cool_fact: Generated components deploy straight to Vercel's hosting with zero extra setup.

name: Vanna AI
description: An open-source framework for building your own text-to-SQL assistant on top of your database.
cool_fact: Because it's open-source, developers can self-host it and fine-tune it on their own schema instead of using a black box.

name: Vapi
description: A developer platform for building AI voice agents that can answer or make phone calls.
cool_fact: Combines speech recognition, an AI model, and text-to-speech into one API, no stitching three services together.

name: Veo
description: Google's AI video generation model, built into Gemini and Google's creative tools.
cool_fact: Frequently cited as one of the top overall picks for AI video quality among current models.

name: Virtual Staging AI
description: Digitally furnishes an empty listing photo with AI-generated furniture instead of hiring a staging company.
cool_fact: Turns an empty room photo into a fully furnished one in under a minute, at a fraction of physical staging cost.

name: Warmly
description: Identifies anonymous website visitors and turns them into AI-qualified sales conversations, with pricing built entirely around annual enterprise contracts, no self-serve monthly plan.
cool_fact: Reported starting prices run from ten to thirty thousand dollars a year depending on which agent (data, inbound, outbound) you license, all seats are unlimited once you're in.

name: Warp
description: An AI-native terminal that pairs a fast, GPU-rendered shell with an agent mode that can plan and run multi-step coding tasks directly in your command line.
cool_fact: Free users can bring their own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google API key instead of paying for Warp's own AI credits.

name: Webflow
description: A visual website builder with AI site-generation features, producing clean, exportable code under the hood.
cool_fact: Generates real, semantic HTML and CSS you can inspect and export, not a proprietary black-box format.

name: Whoop
description: A wearable that tracks recovery, sleep, and strain, with AI-driven coaching insights.
cool_fact: Gives a daily recovery score that adjusts recommended training intensity based on how well you actually slept.

name: Willow Voice
description: Cross-platform AI dictation for Mac, Windows, and iOS with style memory that learns how you write, from a free tier of 2,000 words a week up to $15/month for unlimited use.
cool_fact: Its iPhone keyboard now ships with free, unlimited AI dictation built in, a rare case of a paid tool's core feature going free on mobile.

name: Windsurf
description: An AI-powered code editor whose Cascade agent handles multi-step coding tasks while you stay in the loop.
cool_fact: Now owned by Cognition, the same company behind the autonomous coding agent Devin.

name: Wispr Flow
description: AI voice dictation that writes in your own tone across any app on your computer, free or $12/user/month.
cool_fact: Works system-wide, not just inside one app, so it dictates into email, Slack, or a code editor alike.

name: Wix
description: A website builder with an AI chat-based setup wizard that generates a starting site from a short conversation.
cool_fact: Its AI assistant asks about your business first, then generates a tailored starting site instead of a generic template.

name: Wiz
description: Agentless AI cloud security that scans an entire cloud environment without installing anything on individual machines.
cool_fact: Can map a full cloud environment's risk exposure without ever installing an agent on a single server.

name: Writesonic
description: An AI writing tool aimed at marketing copy, blog posts, and SEO-optimized articles at scale.
cool_fact: Bundles an AI chatbot, article writer, and image generator into one subscription.

name: You.com
description: An AI search engine that lets you choose which underlying model answers your query.
cool_fact: Offers over 30 specialized AI agents built for different tasks like research, writing, and coding.

name: Zapier AI Actions
description: AI decision-making steps inside Zapier automations; new pricing model is easy to overspend on.
cool_fact: Connects thousands of different apps together, the largest integration library in the category.

name: Zed
description: A fast, Rust-built code editor with real-time collaboration and optional AI features, the editor itself is free forever, Pro adds unlimited AI edit predictions for $10/month.
cool_fact: The base editor never requires a subscription at all, you only pay if you want Zed's own hosted AI models instead of bringing your own API key.
